jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin our Medicinal Chemistry team and help shape the future of laboratory automation in drug discovery. We are looking for a passionate and innovative Senior Automation Scientist to drive the scientific, technological, and strategic development of our cutting-edge automation capabilities. As a Senior Automation Scientist, you will design, implement, and maintain automated workflows for synthesis, purification, and analysis. You will collaborate with scientists, automation engineers, and IT teams to orchestrate multi-instrument systems and develop robust processes across leading liquid- and solid-handling and analytical platforms. You will play a key role in advancing innovative solutions that continuously improve the efficiency of in-house workflows.Ready to make an impact with automation-driven science? Apply now and help transform the future of drug discovery.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will design, implement, and maintain orchestration workflows for integrated automation platforms, including scheduler-driven systems, coordinating robotic systems, liquid and solid handlers, analytical instruments, and data systems, covering the entire MAKE cycle from synthesis planning to compound registration.- Your expertise in laboratory automation enables you to design end-to-end data flow concepts and define the requirements for digital interfaces between automation systems and enterprise data platforms (e.g., ELN, LIMS, data lakes, APIs), ensuring seamless and scalable management of experimental data.- You will shape the future automation landscape by designing process architectures, defining system and integration requirements, and guiding the development of scalable orchestration concepts for data-driven laboratory workflows.- You will collaborate closely with chemists, engineers, data scientists, IT and cross-functional teams to translate research challenges into physical prototypes, automated workflows, communicate automation outputs effectively, and translate predictive insights into actionable synthesis and experimental recommendations.- Moreover, you will continuously monitor scientific literature and emerging methods in laboratory automation, physical prototyping, orchestration platforms, liquid handling, analytical instruments and digital lab integration, incorporating state-of-the-art approaches into our automation and data infrastructure to maintain a leading-edge capability.Requirements- Master's degree in chemistry or related field with > 5 years of experience in laboratory automation, robotics or engineering, and basic knowledge of synthetic organic chemistry.- Hands-on expertise in liquid handler programming, lab orchestration and scripting spanning multiple major platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan, BioNex, Opentrons)- Proficiency in modern programming/scripting languages, particularly Python; experience with system integration, APIs, and data interfaces in laboratory environments- Understanding of drug discovery workflows and laboratory processes; strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in complex automation systems- Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams- Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken; German is a plusAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from people with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 26th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid till end of NovemberStep 3: On-site interviews beginning of January 2027Please submit your application documents in English.

The Kelso Professorship of Comparative Law, East European Business Law and European Legal Policy (Prof. Dr. iur. Jens Lowitzsch) at the Faculty of Business Administration and Economics, European University Viadrina invites applications for the position of aTeam Manager / Public Relations (m/f/d)(up to salary group 13 TV-L, 20 hours / week)for the period starting 1 January 2027 until 31 December 2028. The employment contract (formally to be concluded with viadrina Dialog und Transfer gmbh, a daughter of European University Viadrina administering the chair's funds) is currently limited to two years but subject to prolongation or increase in the number of working hours depending on available funding.Background:The Kelso Professorship was established in October 2010, endowed by the Kelso Institute for the study of economic systems (USA). Today it operates based on a cooperation agreement between the Kelso Institute Europe gGmbH in Berlin and the European University Viadrina Foundation, Frankfurt (Oder) of December 2021.The Kelso Institute Europe and the Kelso Professorship conduct studies on policy design with a special focus on the energy transition and consumer co-ownership, employee financial participation, ownership and privatisation, insolvency and restructuring, as well as financial crises and their impact on the welfare state. The research of their interdisciplinary team (economics, law, sociology, political science, and engineering) is largely financed by third-party funding. The Kelso Professorship is a member of the Interuniversity Centre, comprising of Viadrina, Free University of Berlin, the University of Split and Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne.The Kelso Institute Europe and the Kelso Professorship organise events both in the context of our research activities and to communicate and disseminate results. This concern both the research and policy community and the general public and includes a broad variety of types of events (lectures, discussions, movie projections, concerts, annual summer celebration, etc.).The central task of the Team- / Public Relations Manager is the coordination and administration of the cooperation between the Kelso Institute Europe and the Kelso Professorship at Viadrina including team building, public relations as well as knowledge and data management.Your tasks include:- Team building, staff management and coordination of between the two offices (main office is in Berlin; so far, we use MS Teams and a.b.s. rz for Payroll accounting);- Public relations and event management at the Kelso Institute Europe including coordination of the website (https://kelso-institute-europe.de/ (https://kelso-institute-europe.de/) ) and social media presence;- Development & implementation of a strategy for knowledge / data management (organisation of / access to various data repositories like GoogleDrive / Zotero, etc.)- Supporting proposal writing and support in the administration of successfully acquired third-party funded projects;- Supervision of third-party funded projects and collaboration with European University Viadrina's administration, in particular regarding personnel and travel expenses;- Editing and technical editing of publications and activity reports;- Coordination of the Kelso Institute Europe's activities in Berlin with those of the Kelso Professorship at the Viadrina in Frankfurt Oder (80 km from Berlin);- Communication and networking with other Viadrina chairs, the Master of European Studies programme, the Institute for European Studies (IFES).Your profile includes:- Successfully completed university degree in the field of law, economics, business administration or social sciences (minimum Master’s level);- Sound team management and communication skills and relevant practical experience;- Experience in public relations and both website and social media communication;- Good event management and knowledge/data management skills and relevant practical experience;- Experience in the development, implementation and documentation of interdisciplinary projects in a scientific research context, ideally third-party funded;- Experience in the acquisition, administration and accounting of third-party funds;- Experience in project management & reporting and excellent computer skills (MS Office);- Very good written and spoken communication skills (German, English), knowledge of other languages an advantage;- Confident and communicative demeanour in contact with scientists, lecturers and teaching staff as well as partners from practice, business, culture and politics;- Strong teamwork skills, intercultural competence and interdisciplinary understanding.We offer:- Working and living at a research institution with an international profile providing opportunities for interdisciplinary exchange across the EU and worldwide;- An Inclusive and family-friendly company culture – gender equality and promoting female research talents is one of our principal values;- Peer support from colleagues – truly friendly atmosphere at work;- Work-life balance and self-development/family friendly organizational culture due to flexible working hours.The European University Viadrina aims at increasing the number of women among its staff and participates in the research-oriented gender equality standards of the German Research Foundation. Women with equivalent qualification shall be preferred.Disabled applicants with equivalent qualification shall also be preferred. It is recommended to make reference to possible disabilities already in the application.Auszug in deutscher SpracheFür den Zeitraum vom 1. Januar 2027 bis 31. Dezember 2028. Der Arbeitsvertrag (formell mit der viadrina Dialog und Transfer gmbh, einer Tochter des Europäischen Hochschulzentrums Viadrina, das die Mittel des Lehrstuhls verwaltet, abzuschließen) ist derzeit auf zwei Jahre befristet, unterliegt jedoch einer Verlängerung oder einer Erhöhung der Arbeitsstunden je nach verfügbarer Finanzierung.Das Kelso-Institut Europa und die Kelso-Professur veranstalten Veranstaltungen sowohl im Rahmen unserer Forschungstätigkeit als auch zur Kommunikation und Verbreitung unserer Ergebnisse. Dies betrifft sowohl die Forschungs- und Politikgemeinschaft als auch die breite Öffentlichkeit und umfasst eine Vielzahl von Veranstaltungsformen (Vorträge, Diskussionen, Filmvorführungen, Konzerte, jährliches Sommerfest usw.).Die zentrale Aufgabe des Team- / Public Relations Managers ist die Koordination und Verwaltung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Kelso Institute Europe und der Kelso Professorship an der Viadrina, einschließlich Teambildung, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit sowie Wissens- und Datenmanagement.Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:Teambildung, Personalführung und Koordination zwischen den beiden Büros (Hauptbüro in Berlin; bisher nutzen wir MS Teams und a.b.s. rz für die Lohnbuchhaltung); Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Veranstaltungsmanagement am Kelso Institute Europe, einschließlich der Koordination der Website (https://kelso-institute-europe.de/) und der Social-Media-Präsenz; Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Strategie für das Wissens-/Datenmanagement (Organisation von/Zugang zu verschiedenen Datenbanken wie Google Drive/Zotero usw.) Unterstützung beim Verfassen von Anträgen und Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung erfolgreich geförderter Drittmittelprojekte; Betreuung von Drittmittelprojekten und Zusammenarbeit mit der Verwaltung der Europäischen Universität Viadrina Frankfurt (Oder), insbesondere hinsichtlich Personal- und Reisekosten; Redaktion und technische Redaktion von Publikationen und Aktivitätsberichten; Koordination der Tätigkeiten des Kelso Institute Europe in Berlin mit denen des Kelso Professorship Viadrina in Frankfurt (Oder) 80 km von Berlin entfernt; Kommunikation und Networking mit anderen Viadrina-Professuren, dem Master of European Studies-Programm und dem Europäischen Institut für Studien (IFES).Ihr Profil umfasst:Erfolgreicher Abschluss eines Studiums im Bereich Recht, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder Sozialwissenschaften (mindestens auf Master-Niveau); Fundierte Teammanagement- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie relevante praktische Erfahrungen; Erfahrungen in Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und in der Kommunikation über Websites und soziale Medien; Gute Eventmanagement- und Wissens-/Datenmanagement-Kompetenzen sowie relevante praktische Erfahrungen; Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation interdisziplinärer Projekte im wissenschaftlichen Forschungskontext, idealerweise Drittmittelprojekte; Erfahrung in der Akquisition, Verwaltung und Rechnungslegung von Drittmitteln; Erfahrung in Projektmanagement und -berichterstattung sowie ausgezeichnete Computerkenntnisse (MS Office); Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Deutsch, Englisch), Kenntnisse weiterer Sprachen von Vorteil; Selbstbewusstes und kommunikatives Auftreten im Kontakt mit Wissenschaftlern, Dozenten und Lehrenden sowie mit Partnern aus Praxis, Wirtschaft, Kultur und Politik; Starke Teamarbeit-Kompetenzen, interkulturelle Kompetenz und interdisziplinäres Verständnis.Behinderte Bewerber mit gleichwertiger Qualifikation werden ebenfalls bevorzugt. jobs.description: Supply Chain Process Engineer / Project Manager (f/m/d)- Operations Center Neuenburg 2- 80% - 100%- Supply Chain Management- EnglischAs the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4'000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.Your journey begins at our established logistics center in Wohlen, Switzerland (2-3 days per week), where you will get to know our processes, culture, and team while contributing to the cross-site project for the new location from day one. Through targeted training, workshops, and close collaboration with experienced colleagues, you will gain the insights and support needed to successfully transition into your role.This way you experience a fully functioning operation firsthand and actively shape the future in Neuenburg at the same time. During the ramp-up phase, you act as a pragmatic all-rounder: You tackle problems wherever they arise and resolve operational bottlenecks immediately – whether at your desk or on the shop floor.Deine Aufgaben- You will develop, design and optimize logistics processes for our new location in Neuenburg- In Supply Chain Management, you constantly work to improve existing processes, optimally implement new ones, and document them appropriately- You assess new ideas together with relevant stakeholders, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis- You ensure proper training, documentation, and correct application of processes by regularly participating in operational logistics activities- Depending on the situation, you assume different responsibilities during project implementation, including coordinating project teams as a project manager or independently driving optimization initiatives- You identify optimization opportunities, initiate the necessary actions, and ensure their successful implementationDeine Fähigkeiten- A university degree (FH, University, ETH) in Process Management, or a related field, such as Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification- At least 3 years of professional experience in process development or project management in an industrial or logistics environment; experience with automated systems is an advantage as well as experience with SQL- Successfully led and implemented projects, ideally combined with experience in Lean Management- Flexibility to work temporarily in Wohlen and later at the new logistics center in Neuenburg, along with approximately 20% travel within Switzerland- Fluent in English and German, French is an advantage- The capacity to adapt to ongoing changes in the work environment- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectivenessWarum startest du bei uns?- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € and 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefitsDiversity is our culture.To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams. TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.  For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) as Instrument Scientist TOFTOF (m/f/d) Tasks and Responsibilities You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.  Your tasks include:  Scientific lead of TOFTOF's further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications. Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOF Experimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performance Method development in the area of neutron spectroscopy Operation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operation Pursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methods Your responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.  Qualification and Experience PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field. Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.  Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.  Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial. Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile Persuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset. For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.de The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees. Benefits We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such as  TUM's health offers University sports  TUM's internal continuing education and training opportunities TUM childcare (subject to availability)  Very good accessibility by public transport The position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed. Contract We are looking forward to your application via our online-portal https://karriere.frm2.tum.de until  26.11.2026.  Here you may also find other job vacancies at FRM II: https://karriere.frm2.tum.de   Technische Universität München Forschungsneutronenquelle Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) Personalbüro Lichtenbergstraße 1 D-85748 Garching Tel: +49 89 289 12305 oder 14910    www.mlz-garching.de www.frm2.tum.de   As part of your application, you provide personal data to the Technical University of Munich (TUM). Please view our privacy policy on collecting and processing personal data in the course of the application process pursuant to Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (GDPR) at https://portal.my-tum.de/kompass/datenschutz/Bewerbung/. By submitting your application, you confirm to have read and under-stood the data protection information (https://www.tum.de/spezialseiten/datenschutz/) provided by TUM.
